s.note: the Okinawa sushi bar with a legendary swordsmith behind it
s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar and salt. Shape into small fingers. Top with slices of 150g salmon and 150g tuna and a dab of wasabi. Serve on a board with pickled ginger.
Grill 4 corn cobs until charred all over. Mix 50g soft butter with 1 tbsp white miso and brush over. Sprinkle with shichimi togarashi and sliced spring onion.

m.note: the Tokyo restaurant where O-Ren holds court
m.how: Simmer 80ml soy, 80ml mirin, 60ml sake and 2 tbsp sugar until syrupy for tare. Thread 1kg diced chicken thighs onto skewers, some with spring onion pieces. Grill over high heat, brushing with tare. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.how: Whisk 2 tbsp matcha into 300ml warm milk and 300ml cream. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook to 82C. Strain, chill overnight and churn, or freeze and stir every 30 minutes.

d.note: Hanzo and the Bride share a drink
d.how: Mix 2 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp warm water for honey syrup. For each drink, shake 60ml junmai sake, 20ml yuzu juice, 15ml honey syrup and 1 egg white hard without ice for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake again. Strain into a chilled coupe and finish with a twist of lemon peel.
